## Batch 11 authoring complete

Created the 10-item inventory, A/B drafts, proof contracts, coverage record, cross-batch record, notes, and Step 1 decisions. The new local prerequisite is [the formal-series ring lemma](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-hh-one-parameter-formal-series-local-ring.md).

The [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-11.pages.json) records recomputed dependency levels. The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hopf-hecke-algebras/hecke-base-change-semisimplicity-and-deformation.md) and [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hopf-hecke-algebras/hecke-base-change-semisimplicity-and-deformation-examples.md) preserve the design’s limits on determinant criteria and formal label correspondence.

## Checks and handoff

Proof contracts pass for 10/10 items. Dependency, precheck, proof-layout, render, content-policy, and manifest checks passed. Source fetch recorded 8/9 fetch stamps and one documented Wilf drop; the [coverage record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-11.coverage.json) retains the harvest dispositions. The formal-series conventions were checked against [Sambale’s full text](https://benjaminsambale.github.io/pdfs/fopose.pdf). Coverage has one warning: 3 of 14 A-page harvested results are scaffolded; the remaining results have explicit inline or out-of-scope dispositions.

All 10 items are recorded as **escalated** because the required batch-10 page has unfinished Step 1 evidence: its strict proof-contract check reports 55 errors across three items, and its four A-page items lack readiness records. The actual trace definition and theorem are present and were inspected; the batch-11 counterexample proves its trace calculations locally. The [cross-batch record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-11.cross-batch-dependencies.json) keeps that page edge open.

One Step 1 record, for `def-hh-specialization-and-regular-trace-determinant`, was created with an empty `dependencies` array. Its manifest dependencies are listed in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-11.notes.md); I left the escalation unchanged as instructed. The live run remains at `1-scaffold` with the existing owner blocker. No tests or engine-state changes were made.
